messages:
Leah: Quick copy review for the model performance tooltip that appears over the latency/cost badge in the model catalog. Current tooltip: 'Lower latency, higher cost' feels terse and ambiguous. Screenshot in Figma.
Omar: Agreed — users need context. Is it comparing to other models or to the user's baseline? Tooltip should clarify the comparison scope.
Devon: Proposal: 'Lower latency than the default model; may incur higher per-token cost.' That says relative to default which we already surface elsewhere.
Ivy: Nice. Also consider a variation for models that are cheaper but slower: 'Lower cost per token but higher latency under heavy load.' We should avoid absolute claims.
Leah: Tone guidance: keep it short (<= 90 chars), avoid jargon like 'per-token' for new users but keep it for dev-audience. Maybe offer two variants: developer and user-friendly.
Omar: Accessibility: tooltip should be reachable via keyboard focus on the badge and read by screen readers. Use aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip content and ensure it becomes visible on focus, not only on hover.
Devon: Copy variants:
1) Developer: 'Lower latency than default; may increase per-token cost.'
2) User-friendly: 'Faster responses than our default model; may cost more.'
3) Conservative: 'Typically faster than the default model. Monitor cost for your workload.'
Ivy: I prefer 2 for the Console-facing catalog where product teams browse. 1 is better in API docs. 3 is safe for legal-sensitive builds.
Leah: Also add a short CTA in the tooltip for advanced users: 'See benchmarks' linking to the model's performance page. Keep link text short.
design-bot: Task created: UI-MODEL-812 "Model catalog latency/cost tooltip copy + a11y" Assigned: Leah, Omar Due: 2024-10-01
Omar: Implementation notes: keep max tooltip width 320px to avoid wrapping oddities in translations. Add translations note: avoid hard-coded punctuation differences by separating link text.
Devon: Final ask: pick default variant for Console: we'll ship user-friendly by default and add an alternate dev copy in the API docs.
Leah: OK final: "Faster responses than our default model; may cost more. See benchmarks." I'll post the exact i18n keys once legal signs off.
Ivy: Thanks — will check keyboard focus behavior in the next PR.
